title: October 10, 2014: India got its first Nobel Peace Prize - shared with a 17-year-old from Pakistan.

sources.text: Nobel Prize official site - The Nobel Peace Prize 2014, Press release
TIME - India's Kailash Satyarthi wins his country's first Nobel Peace Prize

caption:
October 10, 2014: India got its first Nobel Peace Prize - shared with a 17-year-old from Pakistan.

Satyarthi, founder of Bachpan Bachao Andolan, had spent decades fighting child labour and campaigning for every child's right to education. The prize recognized him as the first Indian-born person ever to win it.

The Nobel Committee deliberately paired an Indian and a Pakistani laureate for their shared struggle against the suppression of children and for universal education - a message as pointed as the prize itself.

Satyarthi's prize wasn't for an invention or an institution - it was for decades spent insisting that childhood itself shouldn't be optional.
